tests.name: Grid reuses buckets, clears stale members and supports negative coordinates

All configurable defaults have schema or asset metadata
Fixed movement and turn-rate bound
Head history follows exact path with no stretching
Collection grows score and body once only
World update collects food by proximity
Maximum length is respected
Boost accelerates and spends score/length
AI actively moves, seeks food, and consumes it
AI disabled removes all opponents
AI target min/max and respawn delay
Death drops collectible gold and reports loss once
Head-to-body collision kills and credits opponent
Boundary death and safe mode
Goal continues playing; boundary ends once and reset works
Frame independence for 60 Hz fixed simulation
Normal gameplay stability / 20 seconds / finite state
AI never uses country flags at spawn, sync, reset or respawn
Score animation is monotonic, retargetable, exact and frame-rate independent
Opponent variants reuse native materials and contain no country motifs
Opponent starting scores scale with round entry, including reset and respawn
Manual food rewards below 50 apply to existing gold and preserve death loot
Player collision assist protects head and neck from both sides, but not body or boundary
